summary: Runtime dependency resolved from an unpinned GitHub repository
details: package.json for @kelvdra/baileys@1.0.6 declares its libsignal dependency as `github:Kelvdra/libsignal` with no commit SHA or tag pin. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the default branch tip of that repository currently contains, without integrity verification, and executes any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tarball on the installer's machine. Whoever controls the Kelvdra/libsignal repository can change what installers of this package run at install time without any version bump to @kelvdra/baileys, and a repository takeover or force-push would silently propagate to every downstream installer. The static match on lib/Utils/generics.js line 393 (`ping`) is a benign network-generics helper (WhatsApp keepalive/GET request handling) and is not itself the source of the risk.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
